_note: Design-day values for New Delhi. Simplified: each surface is taken at its own peak irradiance (not simultaneous), which makes the result a conservative worst case. outdoorPeakC and solarPeakWm2.roof come from Open-Meteo historical data (see source). The vertical orientations are still placeholders. Replace them with values processed from the ISHRAE New Delhi EPW file when available.

source.method: Median across years of the hottest hour (temperature) and the highest horizontal shortwave radiation (roof). Reproduce with scripts/fetch-climate.mjs.

calibration._note: Lumped-capacitance term that stands in for thermal mass and conduction to the indoor air. Tuned so an unshaded 2-storey brick house peaks near 39 °C indoors. Replace with a proper dynamic simulation later.

energy._note: Assumed unconditioned baseline cooling demand, scaled by the change in heat gain. Assumption, not measured data.
